subjects.label: cargo-registry-src
subjects.provenance: The cargo registry source cache, populated by cargo fetch over the lockfiles this machine has built. Shape depends on which crates those lockfiles pull, so it is not a recipe another machine can follow. Kept as the small screening subject for smoke runs.

subjects.label: metabrowser-clone
subjects.provenance: A clone of github.com/jlevy/metabrowser at 433fb6e retained as the loop's base tree, with the node_modules, .venv and .claude worktree state left from its use as a workspace. The clone is reproducible; the workspace state on top of it is not, so the shape is not.

subjects.label: rustup-toolchains
subjects.provenance: The rustup toolchain store for this machine's installed toolchains. Shape depends on which toolchains and targets are installed, so it is not a recipe another machine can follow to the same tree.

subjects.label: system-private-frameworks
subjects.provenance: The sealed macOS system volume's private frameworks, read-only and identical on every Mac running the same OS build (Darwin 25.5.0 here). Reconstructible by installing that build.
